flowTop.title: ICP & Client Strategy
flowTop.body: Define your ideal client company: industry, headcount, hiring velocity, and the roles you place best.

flowTop.title: Build & Enrich Lists
flowTop.body: Scrape verified HR Heads, TA Leads, and CHROs from LinkedIn and Apollo, enriched with hiring signals like funding and job postings.

flowTop.title: Prepare Outreach Assets
flowTop.body: Case studies, cold email sequences, and LinkedIn content tailored to each client's hiring pain points and growth signals.

flowParallel.title: Profile Optimisation
flowParallel.body: Headline, banner, about section, and featured placements crafted to build instant credibility with HR and TA leaders.

flowParallel.title: Content Creation
flowParallel.body: Regular posts on hiring trends and market insights that warm up your target audience before outreach even starts.

flowParallel.title: Thought Leadership
flowParallel.body: Position your firm as the go-to specialist so prospects already trust you when your cold email lands.

flowBottom.title: Launch Client Outreach
flowBottom.body: Cold email and LinkedIn sequences go live targeting HR Heads and TA Leads with full deliverability infrastructure.

flowBottom.title: Follow Up & Nurture
flowBottom.body: Persistent multi-touch follow-ups sharing case studies, placement proof, and market insight until they reply.

flowBottom.title: Book Client Meetings
flowBottom.body: Warm replies convert into qualified calls. Every meeting comes with full context so you can pitch and close faster.

process.title: ICP Mapping
process.body: We define your best-fit client companies by industry, headcount, and hiring velocity, not just any company with an open req.

process.title: List Building
process.body: Hand-verified lists of companies showing real hiring signals: funding rounds, expansion news, and live job postings. No recycled databases.

process.title: Outreach Engine
process.body: Multi-channel sequences, cold email plus LinkedIn, referencing each company's specific hiring signal, sent to the HR Head or TA Lead who owns the req.

process.title: Meeting Handoff
process.body: Qualified meetings with real hiring decision-makers land directly in your calendar. You place candidates; we keep the client pipeline full.
